title: Recall Is Not Honesty: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Architectures for Trustworthy HPC Operational Analytics
summary: Benchmarking multi-agent architectures for trustworthy HPC operational analytics.
question: How should multi-agent architectures be benchmarked for trustworthy HPC operational analytics?
body: This research examines trustworthiness in multi-agent analytics for high-performance computing operations. The work frames recall and honesty as distinct concerns in evaluating operational analytics. Detailed methods, benchmark results, and artifacts will be added with the manuscript.

title: EPIC++: Decentralized Multi-Agent Analytics for Defensible Job Submission Decisions on HPC Telemetry
summary: Decentralized multi-agent analytics for defensible job submission decisions using HPC telemetry.
question: How can decentralized multi-agent analytics support defensible job submission decisions from HPC telemetry?
body: EPIC++ investigates decentralized multi-agent analytics over HPC telemetry to support job submission decisions. This ongoing research focuses on defensible operational decisions. Methods, evaluation details, and artifacts will be added as the work develops.
